detailed_description: The Placeholder Image Generator dynamically creates bitmap images through a RESTful API endpoint, accepting parameters for dimensional specification (width/height in pixels), color models (HEX, RGB, or HSL), and optional overlay text. Developers send HTTP GET requests with query strings defining these attributes, which trigger server-side image processing using the browser image APIs and browser image APIs. The tool generates PNG, JPEG, or WebP formats with configurable compression levels, returning Base64-encoded image data with appropriate MIME types. This eliminates the need for static placeholder files in web development workflows, particularly during HTML/CSS prototyping, responsive layout testing, or component-based UI development. Unlike generic tools, it supports advanced features like text watermarking with custom fonts, aspect ratio validation, and cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) headers for direct browser consumption. Technical teams benefit from its programmatic access, enabling automated testing pipelines and design system documentation with consistent visual placeholders.
usage_steps: Navigate to the tool's dashboard and locate the API URL builder section
Enter numerical pixel values in the 'Width' and 'Height' input fields (minimum 16x16, maximum 8192x8192)
Select background color using the HEX color picker or input custom RGB/rgba values
Optional: Enable text overlay by toggling 'Add Watermark' and entering text content
Choose output format from dropdown (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and adjust quality slider (10-100%)
Click 'Generate Link' to create the image URL or 'Download' to save the binary file
usage_examples: Creating a 300x200 pixel placeholder with #F5F5F5 background for a card layout component
Generating a 800x600 JPEG with 70% quality to test image loading performance metrics
Producing a responsive 16:9 banner with centered white text on a #333333 background
Building a grid of 48x48 pixel icons with varying color schemes for design system documentation
